specs.title: Save a link once and find it again, online or offline

goal.html: A reader saves a link in one step, finds it again by title or tag, and reads it offline.

approach.html: Store each saved link with its fetched text in IndexedDB at save time, so reading offline is a read from the same store the list uses. Fetching the text only when the reader opens an article would fail exactly when there is no connection.

specs.title: Stop duplicate links and duplicate tags from entering the list

goal.html: Saving a known link or a known tag again changes nothing in the list.
